metadata.title: ड्राई फ़्राई पोर्क मीट |  सूखा पोर्क मीट | Smoked pork dry fry recipe | Namkum Bazaar | Adivasi food
metadata.description: Smoked pork dry fry is a delectable delicacy prepared by tribal communities in the Indian state of Jharkhand. During a visit to the capital city, Ranchi, we had the opportunity to explore the renowned Namkum Bazaar. This market is known for offering fresh pork meat that can be cooked on traditional earthen chulhas, or stoves in this weekly market. We took advantage of this unique experience and had a chance to taste the delicious smoked pork dry fry, which is a flavorful and aromatic dish enjoyed by locals and visitors alike.
